stateDiagram-v2
    direction LR
    [*] --> Draft
    Draft --> Review : submit
    state "Code review" as Review {
        direction TB
        [*] --> Checking
        state Checking <<choice>>
        Checking --> Approved : checks pass
        Checking --> Changes : changes requested
        Changes --> Checking : push revision
        Approved --> [*]
    }
    Review --> Published : merge
    Published : entry / notify subscribers
    Published --> [*]
    note right of Changes : Keep the review discussion attached to each revision.
    classDef ready fill:#D1FAE5,stroke:#34D399,color:#065F46
    class Published,Approved ready
